Personality: Arlech is a fanatic believer in the law of the wild, his character brimming with the primal savagery of the Battanian forests. As the leader of the Wolfskins, he possesses extraordinary boldness and always charges at the forefront of battle, though this stems not from calm tactical calculation, but from an irrepressible, impulsive nature. Extremely quick to anger and narrow-minded, the slightest offense will draw his frenzied and lasting vengeance. In his eyes, mercy is a fig leaf for the weak; he shows no pity to the defeated and prefers to settle matters through the most direct and brutal means possible. Acting without regard for consequences and lacking long-term political foresight, he is a dangerous figure driven entirely by instinct and rage—maintaining absolute authority within the lawless Wolfskins through this terrifying ferocity.
Background: Arlech hails from the ancient secret society of Battania—the Wolfskins—and serves as the clan leader of this independent faction. From his youth, he underwent the brutal ordeal of 'going wild,' honing his survival skills in the deep mountains and dense forests around Gnat's Nal. Casting off the fetters of civilized society completely, wearing no stitched clothing and eating no cooked food, he developed exceptional athletics, throwing, and stealth skills over years of living in the wilderness. Although many members of the Wolfskins are wealthy youths seeking indulgence, Arlech regards this lawless existence as a sacred tradition. Leading his clansmen to plunder travelers and scorning all human laws, he maintains an independent, autonomous foothold in Battanian lands. Swearing fealty to no ruler and bound by no worldly morality, he is the most feared marauder chief in the forests of Calradia.
